scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
Kkkkkkkkk!
I have a special event this Halloween that tests your luck and agility.
Are you interested?

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
Come on! Don't be a wuss!
If you collect enough tickets you can get good prizes!
So what do you say?

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
You a 'fraidy cat or something?!
You know you want to try again...
Do you know the rules?
Yes, I know.
No, I don't know.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
Oh, well done! You are alright!
Isn't it fun with zombies??
You know, zombies were people too!
Ha!
Kkkkkkk.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
As I promised
You can get Halloween tickets for cool items.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text: Well, do you want to hear the rules again or, just get back to it...

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
This village is like a virtual Payon.
There are zombies and ghouls roaming around and three southern exits, but only one works.
That's up to you to find out.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
You can't use any skills to kill the ghouls or zombies.
And one more thing...
you shouldn't forget...

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
All participants should be wearing nothing.
Put all belongings in your storage and come back here when your weight is '0'.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
Oh and one more thing!
You can't be riding a PecoPeco or have a Cart.
If you are, then I will remove them before you enter.
Got it?

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text: Remember, there are three exits but only one works randomly, the zombies and ghouls roaming around there can't be killed and you can't be wearing anything.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
Hey...
Come back once you're ready.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
Ok, you are ready.
Let me check your weight.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
Gosh!
There's always a black sheep anywhere.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
You think I wouldn't notice that your weight is above '0'?
You're overweight...

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text: You seem good to go, and your weight is just right.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text: I was quite swamped with my work, so I'm exhausted.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text: I sometimes forget to send you there...

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text: I hope you come back well.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
You want to exchange tickets for prizes?
Good job! Kkkkkk!

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text: Lemme tell you what items you can exchange for.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
5 tickets for Pumpkin Pie.
20 tickets for Pumpkin-Head.
50 tickets for Old Blue Box.
70 tickets for Old Purple Box.
200 tickets for Old Card Album.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text: What would you like to exchange for?
Pumpkin Pie
Pumpkin-Head
Old Blue Box
Old Purple Box
Old Card Album

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
Ok, see you then.
Kkkkkkkk.
Explain it to me.
I want to participate.
I want to exchange tickets for prizes.
I'll come back next time.
Get me back there now!
Please, tell me the rules
I want to exchange tickets for prizes.
I'll come back next time.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
You don't have enough tickets!
Can't you even count?
Please come here with the right number of tickets.

scripts.speaker: Halloween Magician
scripts.text:
Here it is.
Do you need...
anything else?
